steps.description:
A month can have 30 or 31 days, except for Feb. Feb has 29 days if it is in a leap year. Otherwise, it will have 28 days. A year is a leap year if it is either divisible by 4 and not by 100, or it is divisible by 400.

Create a program that asks a user to input a year. Display "leap year" if it is a leap year. Otherwise, display "non leap year".

Follow the test output display format.

Test Input

1600

1994

2100

2020

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input year: 1600 leap year

Example 2 Input year: 1994 non leap year

Example 3 Input year: 2100 non leap year

Example 4 Input year: 2020 leap year
steps.answer:
# ask for year
year = int(input("Input year: "))
# check leap year rule
if (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or (year % 400 == 0):
    print("leap year")
else:
    print("non leap year")

steps.description:
A date is valid when the days are in the correct range for the month. Below shows the number of days in each month:

Jan - 31 days Feb - 28 days (non leap year) Feb - 29 days (leap year) Mar - 31 days Apr - 30 days May - 31 days Jun - 30 days Jul - 31 days Aug - 31 days Sep - 30 days Oct - 31 days Nov - 30 days Dec - 31 days

Create a program that asks a user to input a date in the format D MMM Y (e.g. 1 Jan 2021). If the date is valid, display "valid". Otherwise, display "invalid".

Follow the test output display format.

Test Input

23 Aug 2020

29 Feb 2000

31 Apr 1873

29 Feb 1900

0 Dec 9999

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input date (D MMM Y): 23 Aug 2020 valid

Example 2 Input date (D MMM Y): 29 Feb 2000 valid

Example 3 Input date (D MMM Y): 31 Apr 1873 invalid

Example 4 Input date (D MMM Y): 29 Feb 1900 invalid

Example 5 Input date (D MMM Y): 0 Dec 9999 invalid

January has 31 days. Create a program that does the following: 1. Ask user to input a day in Jan (1 - 31). 2. Increase the day by 1 and display the new date. 3. Pause for 1 second. 4. Repeat step (2)-(3) using while loop until 2 Feb is displayed.

Follow the test output display format.

Hint: Use a variable to store the month and update it when the end of month is reached.

Test Input

25

30

31

1

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input a day in Jan (1- 31): 25 26 Jan 27 Jan 28 Jan 29 Jan 30 Jan 31 Jan 1 Feb 2 Feb

Example 2 Input a day in Jan (1- 31): 30 31 Jan 1 Feb 2 Feb

Example 3 Input a day in Jan (1- 31): 31 1 Feb 2 Feb

Example 4 Input a day in Jan (1- 31): 1 2 Jan 3 Jan ... 1 Feb 2 Feb
steps.answer:
import time
# ask for starting day in Jan
day = int(input("Input a day in Jan (1- 31): "))
month = "Jan"
# loop until 2 Feb is displayed
while True:
    day = day + 1
    # check if past end of Jan (31 days)
    if month == "Jan" and day > 31:
        day = 1
        month = "Feb"
    # display the date
    print(day, month)
    time.sleep(1)
    # stop after displaying 2 Feb
    if month == "Feb" and day == 2:
        break

steps.description:
Below shows the number of days in February:

Feb - 28 days (non leap year) Feb - 29 days (leap year)

Create a program that does the following: 1. Ask user to input a year. 2. Ask user to input a day in Feb within 1 to 25. 3. Increase the day by 1 and display the new date. 4. Pause for 1 second. 5. Repeat step (3)-(4) using while loop until 15 Mar is displayed.

Follow the test output display format.

Hint: Use a variable to store the month and update it when the end of month is reached.

Test Input

2000 25

1999 23

2020 25

2100 1

Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below:

Example 1 Input a year: 2000 Input a day in Feb (1 - 25): 25 26 Feb 27 Feb 28 Feb 29 Feb 1 Mar 2 Mar ... 15 Mar

Example 2 Input a year: 1999 Input a day in Feb (1 - 25): 23 24 Feb 25 Feb 26 Feb 27 Feb 28 Feb 1 Mar 2 Mar ... 15 Mar

Example 3 Input a year: 2020 Input a day in Feb (1 - 25): 25 26 Feb 27 Feb 28 Feb 29 Feb 1 Mar

2 Mar ... 15 Mar

Example 4
Input a year: 2100 Input a day in Feb (1 - 25): 1 2 Feb ... 27 Feb 28 Feb 1 Mar 2 Mar ... 15 Mar
steps.answer:
import time
# ask for year and day
year = int(input("Input a year: "))
day = int(input("Input a day in Feb (1 - 25): "))
month = "Feb"

# check leap year
if (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or (year % 400 == 0):
    feb_days = 29
else:
    feb_days = 28

# loop until 15 Mar is displayed
while True:
    day = day + 1
    if month == "Feb" and day > feb_days:
        day = 1
        month = "Mar"
    print(day, month)
    time.sleep(1)
    if month == "Mar" and day == 15:
        break
